name: Bilingual Mental Health Dataset (BMHD)
description: The Bilingual Mental Health Dataset (BMHD) has 10,672 parallel English–Bengali Reddit posts labelled across 10 mental health conditions plus a neutral class. The Bengali texts were machine-translated, then checked manually and by human evaluation (mean rating 4.68/5). Labels come from four annotators (κ = 0.91 EN, 0.89 BN). It includes benchmark splits and transformer baselines, and is aimed at cross-lingual classification, low-resource NLP, and interpretability research. Research use only, not for clinical decisions.
